`Client` and `AsyncClient` are sibling classes that both inherit directly from `BaseClient`. [Client definition](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:594) · [AsyncClient definition](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:1307)

- `BaseClient` holds shared configuration and state, including authentication, headers, cookies, timeouts, and redirect settings. It also implements `build_request()`, which merges per-request inputs with client defaults. [httpx/_client.py:188](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:188) · [httpx/_client.py:340](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:340)
- `Client` performs synchronous I/O through `transport.handle_request()`. `AsyncClient` performs asynchronous I/O by awaiting `transport.handle_async_request()`. [httpx/_client.py:1001](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:1001) · [httpx/_client.py:1717](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:1717)
